raw_segments.text: Shouldering their bags, they trudged, the red Egyptians.
His blued feet out of turn-it-up trousers slapped the clammy sand,
a dull brick muffler strangling his unshaven neck.
With woman steps she followed, the ruffian and his strolling mort,
Loose sand and shell grit crusted her bare feet,
about her wind-draw face hair trailed.
Behind her lord, his helpmate, being a wass to Roamville.
When night hides her body's flaws calling under her brown shawl from an archway
Her fancyman is treating two royal Dublin's in Oluflands of Blackpits.
Bus her, wap in rogues, rum lingo, for oh, my dimber wapping dell.
A sheffin's whiteness under her rancid rags.
Fumbly's lane that night, the tan yard smells.
